zh.title: 讓多個感測裝置，成為一套可操作的系統。
zh.summary: 串接 BLE 溫度貼片、六部位顯示、電量狀態與手機端韌體更新，處理從裝置連線到資料呈現的完整流程。
zh.purpose: 多部位量測需要同時處理裝置身分、部位對應、連線狀態和更新目標。ThermoPatch 將這些操作集中在 Android App，讓使用者能從同一個介面連接裝置、觀察讀值並選擇要更新的貼片。
steps: 感測與傳輸
配套 nRF52840 韌體透過自訂溫度服務、標準 Battery Service 與 Nordic DFU 提供資料及更新介面。公開 repository 主要保存 Android App，韌體另行維護。
狀態與部位
BluetoothViewModel 管理掃描、GATT 連線與通知；DeviceViewModel 將資料轉為裝置狀態與身體部位讀值，提供頭、胸、左右手臂及左右腿六個顯示位置。
顯示與同步
Jetpack Compose 顯示讀值、電量與充電狀態，聚合資料後串接 Firebase Realtime Database。連線、顯示與雲端保存是不同階段，應分別確認。
更新維護
在設定頁選擇連線裝置與 DFU ZIP，再由 MyDfuService 與 Nordic 回呼呈現進度。明確選擇目標可降低多裝置情境下更新錯誤對象的風險。
decisions: 部位對應與裝置連線分開
畫面需要回答量測來自哪個部位，BLE 層則管理實際連線。兩者分開有助於追蹤裝置替換與斷線。
DFU 是獨立操作流程
將檔案、目標和進度集中在設定頁，讓日常監看不與維護操作混雜。
公開版與後續研究分開
本頁說明公開 nRF52840 App；後續 V2 的 Room、待傳佇列與多裝置同步研究不視為此版本已具備的功能。
results: 可閱讀掃描、通知、部位資料、電量及 DFU 的 App 程式碼與操作流程。
repository 保存 v1.0.1 單元測試摘要：1 個測試、0 失敗。這份摘要不能證明 BLE 多裝置、實機 DFU 或溫度準確度。
連線穩定度、感測校正、斷線恢復、更新中斷和長時間記錄，需要指定手機、韌體與裝置條件的測試。
reproduce: 依 repository 的 Android SDK、JDK 與 Gradle 設定準備環境，使用自己的 Firebase 專案設定。
執行 assembleDebug 與 testDebugUnitTest，分別確認建置與軟體測試。
在相容的實體裝置上核對通知格式、部位對應與電量；DFU 僅使用與目標板及 bootloader 相符的套件。
zh.limits: 這是研究型感測整合專案；六個顯示位置不代表六台裝置並行可靠度已通過驗證，也不代表具備臨床用途或醫療量測精度。
zh.caption: 依公開程式職責繪製的系統架構圖；不是 App 截圖或實測數據。
architecture: 感測裝置
nRF52840 配套韌體提供溫度、Battery Service 與 DFU。
連線與狀態
BluetoothViewModel 管理 GATT，DeviceViewModel 對應裝置與身體部位。
操作介面
Compose 將數值、電量與連線狀態呈現在六個身體位置。
同步與維護
Firebase 保存聚合資料，設定頁另外選擇 DFU 檔案與目標。
analysis: 裝置身分決定資料意義
多部位畫面需要明確知道讀值來自哪個貼片。更換、斷線與重新連接時，部位對應比單純收到溫度值更重要。
測試摘要應對應版本
v1.0.1 的一項單元測試支持該測例的軟體行為；37 項 lint warnings 亦需連同版本閱讀，並不構成手機與貼片的完整接受測試。
更新目標要可辨識
多裝置同時連線時，韌體維護必須能辨識檔案與裝置的對應，更新進度也應與日常感測狀態分開呈現。
zh.media_note: 本頁以架構、流程與可核對紀錄說明成果；目前未選入足以清楚呈現結果的照片或畫面。

en.title: Connecting sensor patches into one usable system.
en.summary: BLE temperature patches, six body-location views, battery status and phone-based firmware updates, connected through an Android workflow.
en.purpose: Multi-location sensing requires device identity, location mapping, connection state and an unambiguous update target. ThermoPatch brings these operations into one Android application for connecting patches, observing readings and selecting a device for maintenance.
steps: Acquire and transmit
Companion nRF52840 firmware exposes temperature, standard Battery Service and Nordic DFU interfaces. The public repository primarily contains the Android app; firmware is maintained separately.
Track state and location
BluetoothViewModel manages scanning, GATT connections and notifications. DeviceViewModel transforms payloads into device state and six body locations: head, chest, both arms and both legs.
Display and synchronize
Jetpack Compose presents readings, battery and charging state; aggregated data is sent to Firebase Realtime Database. Connection, display and cloud persistence are separate stages to verify.
Maintain firmware

Settings provides a connected-device selector and DFU ZIP selection. MyDfuService and Nordic callbacks report update progress. Explicit targeting reduces ambiguity when multiple devices are connected.
decisions: Separate body location from connectivity
The UI answers where a reading comes from; the BLE layer manages the physical connection. Keeping these responsibilities distinct helps diagnose replacement and disconnection.
Give DFU its own workflow
Keep file selection, target selection and progress together so maintenance is separate from everyday monitoring.
Keep release boundaries clear
This page describes the public nRF52840 app. Room persistence and queued multi-device synchronization in the later private V2 research are not attributed to this release.
results: Source and procedures cover scanning, notifications, body-location data, battery state and DFU.
The repository includes a v1.0.1 unit-test summary with 1 test and 0 failures. That summary does not establish multi-device BLE stability, physical DFU reliability or temperature accuracy.
Connection stability, calibration, recovery, interrupted updates and long-duration recording require tests with identified phones, firmware and sensor nodes.
reproduce: Prepare the Android SDK, JDK and Gradle environment specified by the repository and configure your own Firebase project.
Run assembleDebug and testDebugUnitTest to check the build and software tests separately.
Use compatible physical devices to inspect payloads, location mapping and battery state. DFU packages must match the target board and bootloader.
en.limits: This is a research sensing integration project. Six display locations do not establish reliable concurrent operation of six devices, clinical suitability or medical measurement accuracy.
en.caption: System diagram derived from public code responsibilities, not an app screenshot or measured data.
architecture: Sensor nodes
Companion nRF52840 firmware exposes temperature, Battery Service and DFU.
Connection and state
BluetoothViewModel manages GATT and DeviceViewModel maps nodes to body locations.
Interface
Compose presents readings, battery and connection state at six body positions.
Sync and maintenance
Firebase retains aggregated data; settings separately selects a DFU file and target.
analysis: Identity gives data meaning
Multi-location views need a traceable patch identity. Replacement, disconnect and reconnection make location mapping as important as receiving a number.
Read test summaries by version
The v1.0.1 unit result supports one software case. Its 37 lint warnings belong to the same release record; neither establishes full phone-and-patch acceptance.
Make maintenance targets explicit
With several nodes connected, a firmware file must be associated with a recognizable device, and update progress kept distinct from sensing state.

zh.title: 把一次拍照，整理成可追蹤的取像週期。
zh.summary: 以 ESP32-S3 與 OV5640 AF 控制定時照明、對焦重用、JPEG 擷取與 microSD 寫入，讓實驗取像流程可觀察、可追查。
zh.purpose: 長時間生物觀察需要穩定的取像順序與可保存的影像。這個韌體將相機、LED、記憶體和 SD 儲存排成明確週期，並透過日誌區分對焦、取像、待機與寫檔問題。
steps: 喚醒與照明
目前設定目標週期為 10 秒、XCLK 為 20 MHz，先喚醒感測器並開啟 LED，等待 300 ms 讓照明與曝光穩定。這些是設定值。
對焦與擷取
第一次使用中央區域自動對焦並鎖定；後續擷取重用焦點，丟棄一張過渡影格，再取得 QSXGA JPEG。
歸還緩衝區
先將 JPEG 複製到 PSRAM，再歸還 camera frame buffer，讓相機能進入 standby，之後才處理 SD 寫入。
寫入與檢查
影像先寫暫存檔，再重新命名並確認檔案大小。每個 bucket 保存 500 張；開機時回復編號以避免覆寫既有影像。
decisions: 重用焦點的取捨
固定場景可省去每次重新搜尋焦點，但目標距離變動時可能失焦，需以照片與日誌一起判讀。
記憶體換取流程解耦
PSRAM 的 JPEG 副本增加暫時記憶體需求，讓 SD 寫入不必延長 LED 點亮及相機活躍時間。
保存失敗的線索
對焦失敗、frame timeout、短寫入與大小不符各有日誌，方便定位問題發生在哪一層。
results: 公開 README 與韌體描述 10 秒週期、focus-lock reuse、sensor standby 及暫存檔驗證流程。
使用 reuse locked focus、standby enter/wake 與 SD 驗證紀錄，對照實際照片判斷各階段是否完成。
本頁沒有新增取像實驗，不以程式設定推論實際準時率、功耗、光學品質或長時間資料完整率。
reproduce: 準備 XIAO ESP32S3、OV5640 AF、microSD 與穩定供電，依 repository 的 platformio.ini 建置。
記錄首次及後續擷取日誌，確認 AF 搜尋與重用路徑不同。
固定場景後改變目標距離，比對照片清晰度與日誌；另檢查 SD 檔案大小、編號及重新開機後是否覆寫。
zh.limits: standby／wake 時的 VCM 聲音不等於重新對焦；ESP32-S3 內部溫度也不是 OV5640 或馬達溫度。專案名稱不表示已完成太空環境或在軌驗證。
zh.caption: 依韌體順序繪製的取像流程；方塊寬度不代表耗時比例。
architecture: 照明與時序
LED 預熱和相機 wake 決定開始擷取前的狀態。
光學與相機
OV5640 AF 在第一次取像建立焦點，後續沿用鎖定狀態。
記憶體
PSRAM 保存 JPEG 副本，讓 frame buffer 可先歸還。
儲存
microSD 暫存檔、rename 與大小檢查完成影像保存。
analysis: 寫檔與取像分開的好處
先歸還 frame buffer 並待機，能讓較慢的 SD 寫入與相機資源解耦；代價是 JPEG 副本佔用 PSRAM。
固定焦點依賴固定場景
reuse locked focus 紀錄說明走了重用路徑；仍需看照片清晰度，才能知道目標距離與實際焦點是否相符。
檔案完整性有不同層次
寫入大小檢查能識別短寫入，但無法單獨證明 JPEG 可解碼、影像清楚或長時間沒有漏拍。
zh.media_note: 本頁以架構、流程與可核對紀錄說明成果；目前未選入足以清楚呈現結果的照片或畫面。

en.title: Turning a camera capture into a traceable cycle.
en.summary: ESP32-S3 and OV5640 AF firmware coordinates lighting, focus reuse, JPEG capture and microSD storage for observable experimental imaging.
en.purpose: Long-running biological observation needs an explicit capture sequence and recoverable images. This firmware schedules the camera, LED, memory and storage as one cycle, with logs that distinguish focus, capture, standby and file errors.
steps: Wake and illuminate
Current configuration targets a 10-second period and 20 MHz XCLK. The sensor wakes and the LED settles for 300 ms before capture. These are configuration values.
Focus and capture
The first capture uses center autofocus and locks it. Later captures reuse that lock, discard one transition frame and acquire a QSXGA JPEG.
Release the frame buffer
The JPEG is copied into PSRAM before returning the camera buffer. The sensor can then enter standby before SD writing begins.
Save and verify
A temporary file is written, renamed and checked for size. Each bucket holds 500 images; numbering is recovered at boot to avoid overwriting previous captures.
decisions: Reuse focus with a scene constraint
A fixed scene can avoid repeated autofocus searches. A changing target distance may instead produce blur, so images and logs must be interpreted together.
Trade memory for decoupled work
A PSRAM copy requires temporary memory but lets SD writes happen after LED off and sensor standby.
Preserve failure clues
Focus failure, frame timeout, short writes and size mismatches have distinct logs to localize the failing stage.
results: The public README and firmware describe the 10-second target, focus reuse, standby and temporary-file verification.
Compare reuse-locked-focus, standby enter/wake and SD verification messages against the actual captured images.
No new capture experiment was performed for this page. Configuration alone cannot establish achieved timing, power, optical quality or long-run data completeness.
reproduce: Prepare a XIAO ESP32S3, OV5640 AF, microSD and stable power, then build with the repository's platformio.ini.
Record first and subsequent captures and distinguish the autofocus-search and focus-reuse log paths.
Change target distance after establishing a fixed scene, compare sharpness and logs, and inspect file sizes, numbering and restart behavior.
en.limits: VCM noise during standby/wake does not by itself mean a new autofocus search. ESP32-S3 internal temperature is not camera or VCM temperature. The project name does not establish space-environment or orbital qualification.
en.caption: Capture sequence derived from firmware; block width does not represent elapsed time.
architecture: Lighting and timing
LED preheat and sensor wake establish the pre-capture state.
Optics and camera
OV5640 AF establishes a first focus and reuses its locked state.
Memory
A PSRAM JPEG copy releases the camera frame buffer earlier.
Storage
Temporary SD files, rename and size checks organize saving.
analysis: Decouple saving from acquisition
Returning the frame buffer and entering standby separates slower SD work from camera resource ownership, at the cost of temporary PSRAM.
Focus reuse assumes a scene
A reuse-locked-focus log identifies the code path. Image sharpness is still needed to assess whether the target distance matches the focus.
File integrity has layers
Size verification can detect short writes, but alone does not prove JPEG decoding, sharpness or capture completeness over time.
en.media_note: Architecture, workflow and inspectable records explain the outcomes. No photograph or screenshot meeting the presentation criteria has been selected for this page.

zh.title: 把逾時條件，定義到每一個時脈邊緣。
zh.summary: 參數化 Verilog 心跳監測核心，搭配自動檢查 testbench，將逾時、鎖存、清除與重新計時變成可重複驗證的行為。
zh.purpose: 監測系統必須明確定義多久未收到心跳才算逾時、故障訊號是否保持，以及恢復後何時重新計時。本專案先獨立實作這個基本模組，讓時間邊界能在模擬中逐週期檢查。
steps: 輸入與取樣
heartbeat 與 clear_timeout 在 clk 上升緣取樣；rst_n 為非同步低有效 reset。輸入跨時脈同步需由整合層另行處理。
計算等待週期
TIMEOUT_CYCLES 表示連續未取樣到 heartbeat 的上升緣數；預設 25,000,000，在 50 MHz 時脈假設下對應 500 ms。
鎖存逾時
計數達門檻時將 timeout 設為 1 並保持，不因單純等待而自行清除。
清除與重新開始
reset、heartbeat 或 clear_timeout 可清除 timeout 並重設計數器；testbench 使用較小門檻加快邊界與重啟檢查。
decisions: 先固定行為契約
明確寫出取樣邊緣與門檻定義，避免對第 N 或 N+1 個週期的不同理解造成 off-by-one 問題。
用參數縮短模擬
硬體與測試採用相同 RTL，只改門檻。小參數讓邊界案例容易觀察，但仍需涵蓋不同參數範圍。
監測與恢復分層
目前只產生鎖存的逾時狀態；Recovery FSM、電源重啟及完整 BMC 功能不包含在此里程碑。
results: RTL、testbench 與 Questa PowerShell 執行入口均可閱讀，測試入口要求 TEST PASSED 且程序正常結束。
功能模擬不等於 timing closure、板上穩定性或太空環境驗證；這些需要另行記錄。
reproduce: 安裝相容 Questa 工具，於 repository 根目錄執行 scripts/run_heartbeat_sim.ps1。
檢查 TEST PASSED 與 exit code，並用 open_heartbeat_wave.ps1 觀察計數、timeout 及測試檢查器。
整合到 FPGA 前確認時脈、reset、跨時脈輸入同步與 constraints；再獨立進行 synthesis、timing 與上板驗證。
zh.limits: 本頁的互動圖是行為說明，不是模擬器輸出。模組假設同步取樣介面；非同步 heartbeat 需要額外的 CDC 設計。
zh.caption: 依 RTL 繪製的行為架構；互動說明不取代 testbench 或實測。
architecture: 輸入契約
clk 取樣 heartbeat 和 clear_timeout，rst_n 提供非同步清除。
週期計數
elapsed counter 計算連續未收到心跳的週期。
鎖存狀態
timeout 在門檻上升緣成立後保持，直到明確清除。
自動檢查
testbench 以小參數檢查邊界、恢復、清除與重啟。
analysis: 邊界測試針對最常見錯誤
N−1 不逾時、N 逾時的成對檢查，直接辨識計數器比較及更新順序造成的 off-by-one。
清除之後也要檢查
只看到 timeout 下降還不夠；接下來的完整等待區間才能證明計數器確實重新開始。
整合時要補時脈條件
RTL 契約是同步取樣。若心跳來自另一時脈或外部訊號，需另外處理 CDC，並評估脈波是否能被取樣。
zh.media_note: 本頁以架構、流程與可核對紀錄說明成果；目前未選入足以清楚呈現結果的照片或畫面。

en.title: Defining a timeout at the clock-edge level.
en.summary: A parameterized Verilog heartbeat monitor with a self-checking testbench for timeout boundaries, latching, clearing and interval restart.
en.purpose: A monitor needs an explicit contract: how many missing heartbeats constitute a timeout, whether that output stays asserted and when counting restarts. This project isolates that module so cycle boundaries can be checked repeatedly in simulation.
steps: Sample the inputs
heartbeat and clear_timeout are sampled on rising clk edges; rst_n is asynchronous and active low. Cross-clock synchronization belongs in the integration layer.
Count elapsed edges
TIMEOUT_CYCLES counts consecutive rising edges without a sampled heartbeat. The default 25,000,000 corresponds to 500 ms under a 50 MHz clock assumption.
Latch timeout
The output asserts at the threshold and remains high. Waiting alone does not clear it.
Clear and restart
Reset, a heartbeat or clear_timeout clears the output and resets the counter. The testbench uses a smaller threshold for fast boundary and restart checks.
decisions: Specify behavior before integration
Document the sampling edge and threshold to avoid disagreement about whether assertion belongs at edge N or N+1.
Shorten simulation through parameters
The hardware and test share the same RTL with different thresholds. Small values make boundaries observable; parameter ranges still need coverage.
Separate monitoring from recovery
This milestone produces a latched timeout. Recovery FSM, power sequencing and a complete BMC are outside its scope.
results: RTL, testbench and a Questa PowerShell entry point are available. The runner requires TEST PASSED and normal process termination.
500 ms is derived from 25,000,000 / 50,000,000, not measured board latency.
Functional simulation does not establish timing closure, board reliability or space qualification; those require separate evidence.
reproduce: Install a compatible Questa toolchain and run scripts/run_heartbeat_sim.ps1 from the repository root.
Check TEST PASSED and the exit code, then use open_heartbeat_wave.ps1 to inspect the counter, timeout and checker state.
Before FPGA integration, review clock, reset, input synchronization and constraints; perform synthesis, timing and board verification separately.
en.limits: The interactive diagram is an explanation, not simulator output. The module assumes a synchronous sampled interface; asynchronous heartbeats require additional CDC design.
en.caption: Behavioral architecture derived from RTL; the interactive guide does not replace testbench or hardware evidence.
architecture: Input contract
clk samples heartbeat and clear_timeout; rst_n provides asynchronous reset.
Cycle counter
The elapsed counter tracks consecutive samples without heartbeat.
Latched status
timeout asserts at the boundary and remains until an explicit clearing event.
Self-checking testbench
Small parameters exercise boundaries, recovery, clearing and restart.
analysis: Test the boundary as a pair
Checking no timeout at N−1 and assertion at N directly exposes comparison/update-order off-by-one errors.
Inspect the interval after clearing
A falling timeout is only part of recovery. A complete new waiting interval demonstrates that counting actually restarted.
Add clock assumptions at integration
The RTL assumes synchronous sampling. External or cross-domain heartbeats require CDC handling and pulse-capture analysis.
en.media_note: Architecture, workflow and inspectable records explain the outcomes. No photograph or screenshot meeting the presentation criteria has been selected for this page.

zh.title: nRF54L15 × MLX90614
zh.summary: 以 Zephyr／nRF Connect SDK 在 XIAO nRF54L15 上讀取紅外線溫度，透過 BLE 傳送資料，支援每 60 秒取樣及手機要求即時量測。
zh.purpose: 在保留手機連線與操作的條件下，安排間歇取樣及低功耗等待。
zh.limits: 使用 System ON idle 保留 BLE，不是 System OFF。電池壽命估算、實際電流與量測準確度需分別判讀。
zh.caption: 依專案職責整理的架構示意。
architecture: 感測介面
MLX90614 透過 i2c22 讀取環境與物體溫度；overlay 將 SDA／SCL 對應到 P1.10／P1.11。
取樣工作
Zephyr 主執行緒以 semaphore timeout 等待，定期或收到手機命令時執行一次讀值。
通訊服務
自訂溫度、狀態與控制特徵分別處理讀值通知及即時量測要求，保持資料與命令方向清楚。
電源管理
讀值前後 resume／suspend I²C，關閉預設診斷輸出；BLE 保留在 System ON idle 的操作流程。
steps: 啟動周邊與廣播
檢查 I²C 裝置並建立 BLE 服務，等待手機連線。
等待取樣事件
正常週期為 60 秒；寫入 sample 或 measure 可提前喚醒工作，不改變週期設定。
取得並傳送溫度
喚醒 I²C、讀取感測器，將攝氏數值以 ASCII payload 提供給手機。
返回等待
暫停 I²C 並阻塞執行緒，讓作業系統在 BLE 可用的條件下安排省電。
results: 公開原始碼包含接腳配置、BLE 特徵、週期取樣與即時量測控制。
LOW_POWER_ANALYSIS 記錄起始測試約 5.02 V、3.5 mA。此數值屬當時供電與設定，不能視為目前版本優化後的電流。
以 0.66 Wh／720 h 換算約 0.92 mW，說明 30 天目標的平均功率預算；電池容量與負載條件會影響可用能量。
analysis: 取樣頻率不是唯一耗電來源
將 10 秒改為 60 秒可降低讀值事件頻率，但無線連線、感測器待機與板上電源電路仍可能主導平均耗電。比較版本時應保持供電位置和量測設定一致。
可連線與最深睡眠的取捨
手機即時命令需要 BLE 持續可用，因此以阻塞等待搭配 System ON idle。實際續航需同時觀察廣播、連線和讀值三種狀態。
溫度值的意義
物體溫度與環境溫度是不同量；感測距離、視野與目標表面會影響讀值，通訊成功本身不代表校正完成。

使用相容 NCS 環境建置 xiao_nrf54l15/nrf54l15/cpuapp，核對 overlay。
以相容 BLE client 觀察通知並寫入 sample，比對週期取樣和即時取樣路徑。

en.title: nRF54L15 × MLX90614
en.summary: Zephyr/nRF Connect SDK infrared-temperature firmware for XIAO nRF54L15, with BLE data delivery, 60-second sampling, and immediate measurements requested from a phone.
en.purpose: Schedule intermittent sensing and low-power waiting while retaining phone connectivity and control.
en.limits: System ON idle retains BLE; this is not System OFF. Battery-life estimates, measured current, and measurement accuracy must be interpreted separately.
en.caption: Architecture explanation based on documented project responsibilities.
architecture: Sensor interface
MLX90614 ambient and object temperatures are read on i2c22, with SDA/SCL mapped to P1.10/P1.11 in the overlay.
Sampling task
A Zephyr thread waits on a semaphore timeout and reads once for a scheduled or phone-triggered event.
Communication
Temperature, status and control characteristics separate measurement notifications from immediate-sample requests.
Power management
I2C resumes around reads and suspends afterward. Diagnostics are off by default; BLE remains available during System ON idle.
steps: Initialize and advertise
Check the I2C device, register BLE services and wait for a client.
Wait for an event
The normal period is 60 seconds. A sample or measure write wakes the task without changing that setting.
Acquire and notify
Resume I2C, read the sensor and expose an ASCII Celsius payload to the phone.
Return to waiting
Suspend I2C and block the thread so the operating system can idle while keeping BLE available.
results: Public source includes pin configuration, BLE characteristics, periodic sampling and immediate measurement control.
LOW_POWER_ANALYSIS records approximately 5.02 V and 3.5 mA in an earlier setup. This is not a post-optimization measurement of the current revision.
0.66 Wh divided by 720 hours gives about 0.92 mW for a 30-day target. Usable battery energy depends on capacity and loading conditions.
analysis: Sampling is only one load

Changing a 10-second interval to 60 seconds reduces read events, but radio activity, sensor standby and board power circuitry may still dominate. Compare revisions at the same supply point and settings.
Connectivity constrains sleep
Immediate phone commands require BLE availability. Blocking waits and System ON idle support that workflow; lifetime estimates must include advertising, connection and acquisition states.
Interpret both temperatures
Object and ambient temperatures have different meanings. Distance, field of view and target surface affect readings, so a successful transfer alone does not establish calibration.
reproduce: Wire the XIAO and MLX90614 as documented; check the address and pull-ups.
Build for xiao_nrf54l15/nrf54l15/cpuapp in a compatible NCS environment and inspect the overlay.
Observe notifications and send sample from a compatible BLE client to compare scheduled and immediate reads.
Measure advertising, connected and sampling current separately, recording the supply point and firmware settings.

architecture: 操作介面
Kotlin 畫面提供單次量測入口，顯示溫度、單位、時間與狀態。
服務連線
HealthSensorManager 協調 Samsung Health Platform 的連線、權限及 tracker 可用性。
量測生命週期

steps: 確認平台

提出單次要求

處理回呼

停止並顯示
停止 tracker，保留本次讀值供查看，再等待下一次操作。
results: 原始碼與 README 說明按鍵觸發、一次回呼及停止 tracker 的完整操作。

repository 沒有提供可核對的實機量測截圖或統計結果，本頁以程式流程與輸出欄位說明。
analysis: 狀態與讀值應一起看
無資料可能來自權限、服務、tracker 支援或接觸條件。保留錯誤與狀態，才能區分沒有完成量測與有效數值。

重現依賴實體平台

en.title: Galaxy Watch Sensor Monitor
en.summary: A Wear OS/Kotlin app using Samsung Health Sensor SDK for on-demand skin-temperature measurement, displaying wrist and ambient temperatures, timestamps, and tracker status.
en.purpose: Provide a watch-side measurement workflow with visible readings, callbacks, and errors.
en.limits: The README targets Galaxy Watch6 or newer physical devices. The SDK AAR, permissions, and platform policy requirements must be satisfied separately. Not for medical diagnosis.
en.caption: Architecture explanation based on documented project responsibilities.
architecture: User interface
A Kotlin screen exposes a single measurement action and displays temperatures, units, time and status.
Service connection
HealthSensorManager coordinates Samsung Health Platform connectivity, permissions and tracker support.
Measurement lifecycle
SKIN_TEMPERATURE_ON_DEMAND stops after one callback, giving the operation an explicit resource boundary.
Extension scope
Green, red and infrared PPG entry points are retained but disabled by default.
steps: Check the platform
Use a compatible physical Galaxy Watch and SDK; resolve service and permission state.
Request one reading
Measure starts the on-demand tracker and the view waits for data.
Handle the callback
Receive wrist and ambient temperatures with a callback timestamp or error.
Stop and present
Stop the tracker and retain the reading for inspection until the next action.
results: Source and README document the button request, one callback and tracker shutdown.
Skin temperature, ambient temperature, time and tracker status describe one measurement together.
The repository does not include a verifiable physical-watch result screenshot or statistical evaluation. This page explains the source workflow and output fields.
analysis: Read status alongside values
Missing data can originate in permissions, service state, tracker support or contact conditions. Status distinguishes an unfinished operation from a valid reading.
An explicit single-shot boundary
Stopping after one callback simplifies operation, but does not establish continuous logging or day-night trends.
Physical-platform dependencies
The Samsung AAR and platform policy are runtime requirements. An emulator UI cannot verify the watch sensor.

zh.title: 台北公車 Live
zh.summary: 以臺北市官方動態資料建立公車地圖，提供路線與車牌搜尋、標記聚合、站牌到站預估、收藏，以及依路線線形呈現的短時間位置推估。
zh.purpose: 把官方車況快照、路線與站牌資料整合成可互動查詢的地圖。
zh.limits: 開發中。位置推估最長 15 秒，會受回報延遲及匹配信心影響；到站預估不是所選車輛的精確抵達時間。
zh.caption: 依專案職責整理的架構示意。
architecture: 官方資料入口
Node.js 伺服器取得臺北市公車車況、路線、站序與到站預估，對上游請求設定逾時。
共用快取
車況使用 1 秒快取，路線／站序索引保存 6 小時，到站預估共用 15 秒快取。
位置模型
沿官方 BusShape 匹配進度，以 α-β 濾波修正位置與速度，依信心縮短外插。
地圖呈現
MapLibre GL JS 聚合遠景標記，更新可視車點，提供搜尋、收藏、分享及手機資訊卡。
steps: 取得快照
伺服器共用上游資料，失敗時保留上一份並標示延遲。
匹配行駛方向
根據線形、方向與上一段進度建立車輛模型，限制離群資料的影響。
平順呈現
瀏覽器沿短路線折線呈現位置；推估最長 15 秒，之後等待新回報。
查詢路線與站牌
選車後按需載入路線與站序，站牌預估另以官方結果顯示。
results: 路線／車牌搜尋、標記聚合、收藏、路線分享及官方站牌預估均有公開程式。
快照不變時不重建標記，動畫只處理可視車輛與變動車點。
平順移動是依官方回報建立的短時間推估，回報年齡與推估狀態需與地圖一起閱讀。
公開版本 6d9db5e 的 Node 測試套件重新執行，61 項通過、0 失敗。測試涵蓋資料、軌跡、站序、介面及上游處理，不是道路定位精度量測。

動畫改善讀取連續性，但不增加官方資料的採樣頻率。資料回報時間和畫面重繪頻率必須分開解讀。

路線／站牌 ETA 不等於目前選取公車的精確抵達時間；方向、班次與路況會影響結果。

以 npm start 啟動伺服器，開啟 localhost:5180。
搜尋路線、選擇車輛與站牌，核對方向、時間與來源署名。

en.title: Taipei Bus Live
en.summary: An interactive map built on official Taipei bus snapshots, with route and vehicle search, marker clustering, stop arrival estimates, favorites, and short-term position estimation along route geometry.
en.purpose: Bring official vehicle snapshots, route geometry, and stops into an interactive map.
en.limits: Beta. Position extrapolation is capped at 15 seconds and depends on report age and matching confidence. Arrival estimates do not give an exact arrival time for the selected vehicle.
en.caption: Architecture explanation based on documented project responsibilities.
architecture: Official data
A Node.js server fetches Taipei bus positions, routes, stop order and arrivals with upstream timeouts.
Shared cache
Positions use a 1-second cache, route/stop indices six hours and arrival estimates a shared 15-second cache.
Position model
Official BusShape matching and an alpha-beta filter update route progress and speed, with confidence-limited extrapolation.
Map interface
MapLibre GL JS clusters overview markers and updates visible changes, with search, favorites, sharing and mobile information cards.
steps: Fetch a snapshot
Share upstream responses and retain a visibly aged snapshot during temporary failures.
Match direction and progress
Use geometry, direction and earlier progress to constrain the vehicle model and reject outliers.
Present continuous motion
Move along a short route polyline for at most 15 seconds, then await a new report.
Inspect routes and stops
Load geometry and stop order on selection, and present official arrival estimates separately.
results: Public code provides route/plate search, clustering, favorites, route sharing and stop-arrival queries.
Unchanged snapshots do not rebuild markers; animation handles visible vehicles and changed points.
Smooth movement is a short extrapolation from official reports. Read report age and estimation state alongside the map.
The Node suite at public revision 6d9db5e was rerun: 61 passed, 0 failed. It covers data, motion, stop order, presentation and upstream handling, not road-position accuracy.
analysis: Smooth motion is not fresher data
Animation improves visual continuity without increasing the official sampling rate. Distinguish report time from rendering frequency.
Share repeated work
Multiple clients can read one cached snapshot instead of independently increasing upstream requests. Retained snapshots must still show their age.
Arrivals answer a different question
Route/stop ETA is not the exact arrival time of the selected vehicle. Direction, service and traffic affect the interpretation.
reproduce: Install Node.js 20 or newer and dependencies, then run npm test.
Run npm start and open localhost:5180.
Search a route and inspect a vehicle and stop, checking direction, timestamps and attribution.
Compare overview, close-up and reduced-motion states, including delayed snapshots.

zh.caption: 依專案職責整理的架構示意。
architecture: 量測核心
EmStat Pico 執行電化學方法，透過 MethodSCRIPT／UART 與微控制器交換資料。
控制與解析
嵌入式程式將啟動、等待穩定與量測結束組成狀態流程，解析回傳電流與狀態。
操作回饋
TFT 顯示階段與資料，讓使用者能辨識儀器是否仍在等待或已完成。
資料保存
RAM 緩衝與 SPI 共用管理協調 TFT 和 microSD，將結果保存成 CSV。
steps: 開始一次量測
單鍵進入既定方法，將操作者動作轉成可追蹤的儀器狀態。
等待與執行
安排穩定等待及計時安培法，透過串列介面接收量測回傳。
解析與更新
將有效資料轉為顯示與記錄項目，協調畫面刷新和儲存工作。
完成與保存
結束量測後保留 CSV，供後續檢查時間序列與分析條件。
results: 已整理 EmStat Pico、微控制器、TFT 與 microSD 的操作與資料流程。
研究工作涵蓋 SAMD21 至 nRF52840 的平台移植，重點包括串列解析、周邊管理與資料保存。
本頁以儀器原型與操作架構說明整合成果；濃度校正需搭配指定分析物與實驗方法。

電化學量測包含等待與執行階段。清楚的狀態回饋能協助定位未啟動、仍穩定中或資料未保存的差異。

由電流走到濃度
CSV 量測鏈完成後，仍需以空白、標準品及指定電極條件建立校正，才能討論分析物濃度與檢出能力。

en.title: ECsnap Electrochemical Instrument
en.summary: An EmStat Pico, MCU, TFT, and microSD instrument with a single-button workflow for stabilization, chronoamperometry, status feedback, and CSV recording.
en.purpose: Make electrochemical current measurements easier to operate and record in a portable research instrument.
en.limits: Research code is private. Current acquisition and concentration conversion are separate tasks; complete analyte calibration and diagnostic performance are not claimed.
en.caption: Architecture explanation based on documented project responsibilities.
architecture: Measurement core
EmStat Pico executes electrochemical methods and exchanges data with the controller over MethodSCRIPT/UART.
Control and parsing
Firmware organizes start, stabilization and completion states and parses returned current and status.
Operator feedback
A TFT presents the current stage and data so waiting and completion are distinguishable.
Storage
RAM buffering and shared-SPI management coordinate TFT updates and microSD CSV recording.
steps: Start a measurement
One button enters the defined method and makes the operation traceable as instrument state.
Wait and acquire
Schedule stabilization and chronoamperometry while receiving serial measurement data.
Parse and update
Convert valid responses into display and recording items while coordinating storage.
Finish and retain
Keep the CSV for later time-series inspection and analysis.
results: The project organizes the EmStat Pico, controller, TFT and microSD into one operating and data workflow.
Research includes migration from SAMD21 to nRF52840, covering serial parsing, peripheral management and storage.
Prototype imagery and architecture explain integration. Concentration calibration depends on the specified analyte and experimental method.

Electrochemical operation includes waiting as well as acquisition. Status helps distinguish an unstarted method, stabilization and a missing saved record.
Schedule shared resources
TFT refresh and SD writes compete for SPI service. Buffering and batch writes help coordinate acquisition reception with display work.
From current to concentration
A recorded current trace still needs blanks, standards and defined electrode conditions before concentration or detection performance can be assessed.

Check CSV units and conditions before calibration or cross-run comparisons.

zh.title: Smart Stop-Flow

zh.caption: 依專案職責整理的架構示意。
architecture: 方法設定
Android 端設定實驗步驟，保存方法與操作所需的參數。
流體控制
ESP32-S3 以狀態機安排幫浦與微閥序列，包含預壓、進樣、清洗和異常停止。

steps: 建立方法
設定步驟與時間，保存本次使用的方法快照。
進樣與停流
控制幫浦／閥件執行流體步驟，同時追蹤當前狀態。
同步觀察
